question: Under what structural conditions are FSCR, FSCCR, and FSMR required by the BFP, and who prepares them?
answer:
The structural conditions for FSCR (Fire Safety Clearance Report), FSCCR (Fire Safety Clearance Certificate Renewal), and FSMR (Fire Safety Measures Plan Review) are required by the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) when there are changes in the structure or use of a building or establishment.

The preparation of these documents is not explicitly stated in the provided sources. However, it can be inferred that the Zoning Officer IV of the City Planning and Development Office (CPDO) presents the application to the CHLURU (City Hall Land Use and Regulatory Unit) committee [S3] and LZBA (Local Zoning Board of Appeals) TWG (Technical Working Group) members [S2], who may recommend the necessary documents during the meeting.

Citations:
- [S2] City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf | printed page 667 | chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0038-C002
- [S3] City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf | printed page 710 | chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0081-C002

ground_truth: FSCR/FSCCR/FSMR are required if the building/facilities/structures are required to install any or a combination of wet standpipe, automatic fire suppression, or automatic fire detection and alarm systems. FSCR consists of plans, specifications and design analysis per building, prepared and duly signed by the Engineer/Architect-of-Record and his/her Fire Safety Practitioner. FSCCR compiles approved submittals, test and acceptance forms for fire protection and life safety features as part of as-built documents turned over by the contractor to the owner; it is duly signed by the Contractor/Construction Manager and his/her Fire Safety Practitioner. FSMR is prepared by the building owner, his/her fire safety practitioner or authorized representative, and duly signed by the Building Administrator and his/her Fire Safety Practitioner during regular annual fire safety inspection. The matrix associates FSCR with FSEC, FSCCR with occupancy FSIC, and FSMR with new business without valid occupancy-stage FSIC and the two renewal columns; blank cells are not exemption statements.
